headline: Gold prices drop by 1,691 BDT per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced gold and silver prices following a decline in the international market.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have decreased by 1,691 BDT per bhori, effective from Saturday morning. The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) stated that the price adjustment was made due to a drop in the local price of Tejabi gold and the international market.
caption:
Gold prices just dropped by 1,691 BDT per bhori!

Gold prices in Bangladesh have decreased by 1,691 BDT per bhori, effective from Saturday morning. The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) stated that the price adjustment was made due to a drop in the local price of Tejabi gold and the international market.

headline: Asian Games: Bangladesh beat Indonesia 3-1 for second straight win
summary: The men's hockey team secured a victory in Pool A, keeping their group-stage qualification hopes alive.
details: Bangladesh secured their second consecutive victory in the men's hockey competition at the 20th Asian Games, defeating Indonesia 3-1 in their Pool A encounter.
Indonesia took an early lead in the sixth minute through Fathur Mochamad, but Bangladesh responded quickly with an equalizer from penalty-corner specialist Amirul Islam five minutes later.
Amirul Islam struck again in the 31st minute to put Bangladesh ahead, while Rasel Mahmud Jimmy added a third goal via a fine field goal six minutes later.
This victory follows a 5-1 win over Sri Lanka in their previous match, marking a strong recovery for the team.
The team had previously suffered losses against South Korea (5-0) and hosts Japan (6-1) earlier in the tournament.
Bangladesh will now face a crucial final Pool A match against India on September 28 to determine their group-stage qualification.
caption:
Two wins in a row! 🇧🇩

Bangladesh's men's hockey team triumphs over Indonesia 3-1 at the Asian Games.

Bangladesh secured their second consecutive victory in the men's hockey competition at the 20th Asian Games, defeating Indonesia 3-1 in their Pool A encounter.

Indonesia took an early lead in the sixth minute through Fathur Mochamad, but Bangladesh responded quickly with an equalizer from penalty-corner specialist Amirul Islam five minutes later.

Amirul Islam struck again in the 31st minute to put Bangladesh ahead, while Rasel Mahmud Jimmy added a third goal via a fine field goal six minutes later.

This victory follows a 5-1 win over Sri Lanka in their previous match, marking a strong recovery for the team.

The team had previously suffered losses against South Korea (5-0) and hosts Japan (6-1) earlier in the tournament.

Bangladesh will now face a crucial final Pool A match against India on September 28 to determine their group-stage qualification.
